notes: Functions allowed to differ between prioritization-board.html (card) and prioritization-board-grid.html (grid). PRESENTATION ONLY. Anything touching lane math, Mission Critical, per-service flooring or the exports must NEVER appear here — if a name below ever starts doing arithmetic, that is the bug.

functions.gridRows: grid only — the rendered row elements, for selection and keyboard nav
functions.gridIds: grid only — requirement ids in displayed order
functions.setCur: grid only — sets the selected row and repaints the inspector
functions.gridMark: grid only — puts the .cur class on the selected row
functions.gridAfterRender: grid only — keeps the selection valid across re-render, re-sort and drag
functions.inspField: grid only — one labelled field in the inspector
functions.inspectorBody: grid only — renders the docked inspector. Every FIGURE comes from tiers()/askTot()/mcShortOf() and is never recomputed here; its one write is migrateSplit(), which promotes a legacy split to per-service vectors because this build has no row-expander editor left to do it
functions.gridSticky: grid only — measures the sticky scorecard stack so the column header pins below it
functions.svcTable: grid only — RETIRED there: the docked inspector edits the per-service requirement values, the Disc/Mand split, the minimum useful increment, the absorber and the award schedule. The card build has no inspector and keeps the full editor
functions.rowChipsHtml: grid only — the funding chip is a status BADGE, not a second editor; the split is set on the inspector. The card build keeps it as a picker
functions.rowMenuHtml: grid only — description, note, Record and the plan-event rename are inspector chips there, so the menu keeps only what the inspector has no equivalent for: the consequence, the CCaR record-name rename, and lifecycle
functions.gridDedupe: grid only — strips the row handlers that duplicate the inspector, so render() stays shared and byte-identical with the card build
functions.drawerNarrow: grid only — is the viewport below the 1400px breakpoint where the docked inspector becomes a drawer. The card build has no inspector to dock or slide
functions.drawerOpen: grid only — slides the RECORD panel in when a row is selected below 1400px, and is inert above it. The panel used to be display:none there, which left this build with NO editor at all on a 1366px laptop because the row editor was retired
functions.drawerClose: grid only — slides the drawer away and returns focus to the row it was opened from
functions.drawerSync: grid only — the window can be resized across the breakpoint with the drawer open; this stops the panel being half docked and half drawer
functions.drawerBar: grid only — the drawer's own close control, built with the panel body so it can never be left behind pointing at a requirement that has gone

rowChipsHtml: grid only — the row there carries identity, money and the band, nothing else. The impact chip moved to the RECORD panel's 'Open on the row' group and the funding split is a panel field, so neither is on the row. The card build keeps both: it has no panel, and the funding chip is its only picker for the split
rowMenuHtml: grid only — description, note, Record, the plan-event rename and now the consequence are all edited from the RECORD panel there, so the menu keeps only what the panel has no equivalent for: the CCaR record-name rename and the row's own lifecycle. The card build has no panel and keeps the full menu
